title: Hyliion Announces Dual Listing on NYSE Texas
summary: Decision connects Hyliion's headquarters and manufacturing base to the capital markets fueling Texas' energy and technology growth. AUSTIN, Texas —
body_markdown:
*Decision connects Hyliion’s headquarters and manufacturing base to the capital markets fueling Texas’ energy and technology growth.*


AUSTIN, Texas —[Hyliion Holdings Corp.](https://www.hyliion.com/) (NYSE American: HYLN), a developer of modular power plant technology, today announced the dual listing of its common stock on NYSE Texas, a fully electronic equities exchange headquartered in Dallas, Texas that launched in 2025.


“Texas is Hyliion’s headquarters and the site of our core manufacturing operations,” said Thomas Healy, Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Hyliion. “This dual listing reflects the trajectory of Hyliion and puts us directly alongside the capital markets driving the state’s energy and technology future. We’re proud to be part of this momentum.”


“Hyliion embodies the innovation and ambition that’s reshaping Texas’ energy landscape,” said Bryan Daniel, President of NYSE Texas. “We’re excited to welcome Hyliion to NYSE Texas and look forward to supporting its growth as it brings next-generation power technology to market.”


Hyliion will maintain its primary listing on NYSE American and will trade under the same ticker symbol, “HYLN,” on both exchanges. The NYSE Texas listing will become effective on Sept. 22, 2026.


**About Hyliion**


Hyliion is committed to creating innovative solutions that enable clean, flexible and affordable electricity production. The Company’s primary focus is to provide modular power plant technology that can operate on various fuel sources to future-proof against an ever-changing energy economy. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, and with research and development in Cincinnati, Ohio, Hyliion is initially targeting the commercial and waste management industries with a locally deployable KARNO Power Module that can offer prime power as well as energy arbitrage opportunities. Beyond stationary power, Hyliion will address mobile applications such as vehicles and marine vessels. The Company aims to offer innovative, yet practical solutions that contribute positively to the environment in the energy economy. For further information, please visit[www.hyliion.com.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.hyliion.com%2F&esheet=54584579&newsitemid=20260806155737&lan=en-US&anchor=www.hyliion.com.&index=2&md5=40bea04550f0884604a81140caf1831d)
